a.description: A `Tensor`. Must be one of the following types: `float32`, `float64`, `int32`, `uint8`, `int16`, `int8`, `int64`, `bfloat16`, `uint16`, `half`, `uint32`, `uint64`. A tensor containing 3-element vectors.
constraints: must be one of the following types: float32, float64, int32, uint8, int16, int8, int64, bfloat16, uint16, half, uint32, uint64
a must be one of float32, float64, int32, uint8, int16, int8, int64, bfloat16, uint16, half, uint32, uint64
a and b must be the same shape

b.description: A `Tensor`. Must have the same type as `a`. Another tensor, of same type and shape as `a`.
constraints: must have the same type as a
b must have the same dtype as a
a and b must be the same shape

output.description: A `Tensor`. Has the same type as `a`.

constraints: a and b must be the same shape
